page: Microsoft Azure FX96-24mds_v2 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the FXmdsv2 server family. This server is built on the x86_64 architecture featuring an Intel processor with 24 dedicated virtual CPUs. It is designed for workloads requiring massive memory capacity, providing 1832.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 76.33 GB of memory per core.

The server features 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is premium storage capable. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, this server offers high resource density for memory-bound and storage-heavy operations. The hardware profile is optimized for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and enterprise applications that require massive RAM allocations alongside fast local storage.
